jobs.title: AI Software Engineer (AI Lab)
jobs.description:
About Agicap


Créée à Lyon en 2016 par trois entrepreneurs français, Agicap est l'une des scale-ups avec la plus forte croissance d’Europe, avec plus de 8 000 clients, 600 employés et une croissance rapide du chiffre d'affaires (multiplié par 7 entre 2021 et 2024). Agicap fait partie du French Tech 120, qui récompense les startups les plus prometteuses de France.

Agicap permet aux directions financières des entreprises de taille intermédiaire de gérer et de prévoir efficacement leur trésorerie, de payer leurs fournisseurs et de se faire payer. En combinant un système de gestion de trésorerie avec des solutions de gestion des comptes fournisseurs et des comptes clients sur une seule plateforme, Agicap ambitionne de devenir la nouvelle référence en matière de gestion de trésorerie pour les entreprises de taille intermédiaire.

Nous avons levé 145 millions d’euros depuis notre création, auprès de fonds de capital-risque prestigieux tels qu’AVP, Greenoaks, Partech et BlackFin, avec un dernier tour en novembre 2024.

Ces ressources supplémentaires alimentent encore davantage notre innovation produit, nous permettant de croître significativement et d’accélérer notre expansion internationale à travers le monde.

Nous sommes convaincus que notre succès réside dans nos équipes passionnées et dévouées, engagées à bâtir une entreprise où chacun peut évoluer et construire sa carrière. Nous sommes constamment à la recherche de nouveaux talents, visant l’excellence et prêts à rejoindre notre aventure ambitieuse !


Agicap est en train de devenir une AI-first company. Nous formons l'ensemble de nos employés à travailler avec l'IA et à automatiser eux-mêmes une partie de leurs tâches. Certains projets sont trop longs, trop transverses ou trop techniques pour être portés par une équipe métier seule.

C'est le rôle de l'AI Lab.

C'est l'équipe pivot qui construit les outils internes qui changent la façon dont Agicap travaille au quotidien. Notre boussole : impact opérationnel rapide, itérations courtes, travail à 360° avec toutes les équipes (Sales, CS, Finance, Produit, Marketing, Data, C-level).

C'est une création de poste : l'accélération de l'IA change nos process et notre manière de bosser. On a besoin d'un renfort senior pour accompagner cette transition et l'inscrire dans des pratiques qui tiennent sur le long terme.

L'équipe que tu vas rejoindre : 
  • 3 personnes, toi inclus : un ingénieur IA junior, un Tech Lead à mi-temps (qui sera ton manager), un Product Manager.
  • Ton rôle : apporter le recul technique qui manque aujourd'hui dans l'équipe (infra, architecture, maintenabilité, scalabilité) — construire vite, mais sans creuser de dette pour demain.
  • Tu es en interaction directe avec toutes les équipes métier d'Agicap : c'est un poste très transverse, très exposé.

⚡️ Responsabilités :

Tu alternes entre cadrage rapide, build et itération :

  • Comprendre le besoin d'une équipe métier en direct, cadrer ce qui a réellement de l'impact vs. ce qui est du confort, prioriser.
  • Construire les outils internes de bout en bout : cadrage → dev → mise en prod → itération avec les utilisateurs.
  • Faire évoluer la plateforme IA commune : serveurs MCP, intégrations, outillage transverse mis à disposition de toute l'entreprise.
  • Prendre les décisions techniques qui structurent le Lab : infra, choix de stack, architecture. Il n'y a pas d'existant lourd auquel te conformer, tu construis pour scaler.
  • Élever le niveau technique de l'équipe : mentoring de l'IA Engineer junior, transmission des bonnes pratiques, revue de code utile.
  • Identifier proactivement les process où l'IA apporte un vrai gain — et construire la solution.

    • Exemples de chantiers sur tes 6 premiers mois :

    • Feedback loop produit : construire un système qui digère l'ensemble des logs de feedback client (calls, RFP, remontées CS) et produit des recommandations priorisées pour les Product Managers. Aujourd'hui la donnée existe mais on ne la digère pas.
    • Chantier infra MCP : mettre à disposition des collaborateurs Agicap des serveurs MCP connectés à leurs outils du quotidien, à l'échelle.

⚡️Comment on travaille :
  • Autonomie totale : équipe de 3, tu décides, tu assumes tes choix.
  • Ship rate élevé : on livre quotidiennement, on mesure, on itère. Pas de sprints à la papa.
  • Full remote ou hybride Lyon/Paris, comme tu préfères. Venues à Lyon possibles (~1 fois toutes les 6 semaines) mais jamais obligatoires.
  • IA au quotidien dans le delivery : on utilise Claude, OpenAI, Mistral au quotidien pour construire — on n'observe pas la vague IA, on est dedans.
  • Anglais requis : beaucoup de collaborateurs sont anglophones. Ton binôme est francophone.

    • 👀 Le profil recherché:

    On vise un profil senior avec expérience de Tech Lead — quelqu'un qui a déjà pris des décisions impactantes, poussé des sujets techniques exigeants, et exploré activement le terrain IA :

    • ~4-5 ans d'expérience minimum en dev, sur des projets réellement mis en production.
    • Expérience de Tech Lead ou équivalent : tu as déjà driver des décisions d'architecture et d'infra, tu sais arbitrer entre vélocité et dette.
    • Pratique concrète et récente des LLMs : tu as essayé des choses, poussé des expérimentations, testé Claude / OpenAI / Mistral. Tu es moteur sur ces sujets, pas suiveur.
    • Python et TypeScript dans ta boîte à outils. Le langage compte moins que ta capacité à choisir le bon outil pour le bon problème.
    • Bases techniques solides : tu maîtrises et comprends ce que tu livres.
    • Capacité à livrer vite et à prioriser ce qui a réellement de l'impact — mode Doer, pas mode powerpoint.
    • Proactivité et curiosité : tu identifies des opportunités que personne n'a formulées, tu vas chercher.
    • Anglais professionnel courant.
    • Autonomie assumée : dans une équipe de 3, tu ne peux pas te cacher. 

    ⭐ Stack et outillage
  • LLMs : Claude (Anthropic), OpenAI, Mistral — l'équipe n'est pas mono-provider, tu choisis le bon modèle pour le bon usage.
  • Langages : majoritairement Python et TypeScript.
  • Infra : à toi de la construire, avec un vrai droit de décision — pas d'existant lourd.
  • Outillage IA en interne : serveurs MCP, plateforme IA commune, agents connectés aux outils métier.
  • Cycle : Continuous Delivery, mise en prod quotidienne, feedback utilisateur direct.

    • 🎁 Ce qu'on offre
    • Un poste à impact direct et visible dans une AI-first company de 600 personnes.
    • Un cadre ultra-responsabilisant : autonomie, ownership, décisions techniques à ton niveau.
    • Rémunération : 55K€ - 70K€ selon expertise + prime vacances SYNTEC.
    • CDI, forfait en heures, 39h dont 4h supplémentaires payées.
    • 25 jours de congés payés + 10 jours de congés flexibles (utilisables dès l'arrivée).
    • Full remote ou hybride (Lyon/Paris), venues à Lyon non obligatoires.
    • Mutuelle Alan (extension famille possible), titres restaurant Swile (11€/jour dont 6,50€ pris en charge).
    • Avantages CSE : carte KDO annuelle, Gymlib/EGYM wellpass, etc.
    • Démarrage ASAP.

    ⏳ Process de recrutement :
    1. Screening avec l'équipe Talent Acquisition — présentation du poste et validation du fit (30-45 min).
    2. Deux entretiens techniques avec l'équipe AI Lab (formats et sujets communiqués en amont).

    Feedback sous 24-48h à chaque étape. Process rapide, transparent.

    Agicap s'engage à garantir l'égalité des chances pour tous et favorise un environnement de travail inclusif qui valorise la diversité !

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
🪐 Discover our galaxy
 
Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different:
 
- A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries
- A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth
- Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI
- A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently
 
Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 🪐
 
At Malt we believe that Ambition is the Way, so all lists of missions and responsibilities are non-exhaustive.

Explore your future career  

As a Staff Software Engineer at Malt, you play a pivotal role in shaping the company's technical direction, architecture, and execution.
 
Staff Engineers are technical leaders who innovate to build solutions that will support the company's growth.
 
This is achieved through individual contributions, applying technical skills to deliver products that will revolutionise the world of freelancing. 
 
Additionally, you provide technical leadership by addressing organization-wide design and architectural challenges and guiding their implementation.
 
Finally, you play an active role in the lead engineering group, contributing to the definition and enhancement of company-wide software and systems engineering standards.

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. 

Reporting to the Regional Sales Director, the Strategic Account Executive is a field-based position with ownership of an assigned territory (Eastern/Central Europe) focused on net new logo and upsell opportunities. You will have the ability to utilize a robust internal resource model, a broad tech stack, and a global partner directory to position yourself for future success. 

We will consider applicants based in the UK or Netherlands.

  • Create, implement, measure and review a personal plan that drives achievement of performance goals aligned to the regional sales strategy. 
  • Position and articulate our value proposition to customers to maximize the business opportunity. 
  • Negotiate and close complex contracts with the support of global partners. 
  • Report on sales activity and forecasts to senior management. 
  • Prepare indicative subscription pricing and customer offers, including reviewing broader opportunities such as training and professional services modules, and guides request for proposal responses. 
  • Provides customer feedback to marketing, customer success, product management, and engineering teams. 
  • Work collaboratively to acquire additional/specialist resources as needed.  

You have:

  • Proven ability to win net new business.
  • Results-oriented with multiple years meeting or exceeding quota within the market. 
  • Sustainable record of signing strategic and large projects, with long and complex sales cycles. 
  • A combination of experience in selling to both public and private sector accounts is preferred.

  • Successful record dealing with strategic buyers. 
  • Deep knowledge of the relevant key drivers of change in the industry. 
  • Background working with regional/national/global partners and system integrators.
  • Prior training and experience in value selling and account planning methodologies. 
  • Flexibility to travel to the assigned region as required

  • Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description:
Who We Are

AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint.

We're at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, the context-engineering layer for AI-driven software delivery used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration and efficiency, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, Bazel, npm, and Python, with support for additional build tools coming soon.

We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. We're investing deeply in making Develocity's unique data and decades of domain expertise accessible to both humans and AI agents, with trust, evidence, and explainability at the core of everything we build.

We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as DuckDuckGo, Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community.

Our Values

Seek to Understand: Everything starts with listening and understanding; we strive to understand diverse viewpoints, problems, and motivations. Before we take action, we ensure we truly grasp the challenges, perspectives, and goals. 

Know the Why: We approach our work with a clear sense of purpose, ensuring every step is deliberate and focused. We take meaningful action with urgency, but never at the expense of thoughtful consideration. 

Innovate & Iterate: We embrace challenges and are not afraid to try new things, even if they might fail. With a deep understanding and a clear purpose, we can develop creative, bold solutions to tackle challenges.

Own the Outcome: We are empowered to take initiative, and we maintain transparency in our work and its outcomes. When we execute, we take responsibility for our decisions, measure the success of our innovations, and learn from the results.

Who You Are

We are looking for a hardworking, driven Account Executive to join our high-performing team. In this role, you will be the face of Develocity for enterprise prospects and customers in the New York and East Coast US region, focusing on driving revenue growth and new business acquisition.

You'll act as a primary point of contact for our enterprise accounts in your territory. Your goal will be to guide these organizations on their journey with Develocity to unlock comprehensive data throughout the build process, empowering you to detect the unknown unknowns so you can ship faster, reduce risk, and lower costs, all while maintaining the highest standards of quality and compliance. You will be responsible for formulating and executing a sales strategy to grow your territory and acquire new customers.

Responsibilities

As an Account Executive, you will manage the entire sales cycle, from lead to close, to expand Develocity adoption. Your main focus will be to consistently achieve or exceed quotas and drive pipeline growth.

You will do this by:

  • Developing and executing strategic account plans to target new logos not already covered by other teams.
  • Building a robust pipeline and preparing accurate forecasts for large-scale, multi-year deals.
  • Cultivating strong customer relationships and consistently engaging with key engineering and C-level executives.
  • Leading the full sales cycle, from initial outreach to close.

🏗️ About the role

We’re hiring a data engineer to build the ingestion and search systems behind Solve Intelligence’s AI products.

Our sources include global patent literature, case law, technical standards and contributions, scientific databases, academic papers, and content from across the web. The data spans structured records, documents, images, audio and video. You’ll work across bulk ingestion and on-demand retrieval, making this information searchable and useful in our products

You’ll own systems from source acquisition through to serving queries. The work includes:

  • Large-scale ingestion. Build and operate high-throughput, resumable pipelines for large datasets, with efficient incremental updates, monitoring and recovery from failures.

  • Document processing and data quality. Extract useful content from complex documents and other formats. Handle malformed records and changing schemas, and validate outputs while preserving structure and metadata.

  • Search and serving. Build keyword, vector and structured search, and design schemas, indexes and partitioning for fast queries over tens to hundreds of millions of records.

  • Connecting information across sources. Link patents, scientific records and supporting documents, preserve dates and versions, and make results traceable to their original sources.

  • Performance engineering. Profile parsing, ingestion, database builds and queries throughout development, testing against representative datasets at realistic scale. Diagnose CPU, memory and storage I/O bottlenecks, and tune jobs and infrastructure for throughput, latency and cost.

You’ll work closely with our AI researchers and product engineers, with substantial freedom to choose the approach and build the systems yourself.

🛠️ What you bring

Must haves:

  • Strong Python and SQL, with experience designing and operating production databases.

  • Solid experience building and operating production data pipelines over large, messy datasets.

  • A good understanding of schema design, indexing and query optimisation.

  • A track record of diagnosing and fixing performance bottlenecks in live systems through profiling and measurement.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with PostgreSQL/pgvector, OpenSearch (or Elasticsearch), Spark/Delta Lake, AWS, NoSQL databases, or Rust/C++ is useful.

jobs.title: Founding Account Executive, New Business
jobs.description:
About Fyxer

Fyxer launched in May 2024 and hit $1M in revenue across 3,000 paid users without spending a dollar on marketing. We've since gone from $1M to $30M ARR and raised a Series B led by Madrona, with Lakestar, 20VC and Marc Benioff behind us.

Far more people start using Fyxer every month than we can speak to. Nobody owns turning those users into paying teams. That's the biggest surface in the company, and it's this seat.

The role

You work accounts where someone is already using the product. One person trying Fyxer is often a door into a 500-person company. Spot those fast, get to the people who sign, prove out the pattern so it repeats.

You run the full cycle. First touch, discovery, demo, pricing, close. No handoffs.

You also write the first version of everything: the pitch, the sequences, the objection handling, the qualification bar. None of it exists yet. What you prove out is what the next reps get trained on.


What we're looking for

  • 30+ deals you closed yourself in the last 12 months, and quota hit in two of your last three measured periods

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders at all levels of an organization

  • You've worked without a playbook, or built one where none existed

Three years in or twelve. We care what you've done, not where you did it.

How we work

Time with customers is the only thing that compounds. Everything else is overhead. We automate the research, the notes, the CRM and the follow-up with our own product.

We move fast and decide in the meeting. You own your outcomes. We challenge each other directly. It's intense and it isn't for everyone.


The Fyxer Reality: Why We Win

  • The Trajectory: We grew from $1M to $30M ARR with a team of just 32.

  • The Evidence: Ranked 7th in Andreessen Horowitz’s list of top AI apps. Every other company in that top 10 is valued at $10B+. We are the outlier.

  • The Culture of Agency: We hire exceptional people, give them total ownership, and get out of their way.

  • Zero Bureaucracy: No slow-motion decision-making. No "alignment" meetings for the sake of it.

 

This culture is intense; it requires focus and discipline. So we’ll do everything we can to remove distraction, support your wellbeing, and reward your impact

The basics

  • Remote, US

  • Compensation: $100K base / $200K OTE (plus equity, depending on location)

  • Uncapped with accelerators above 100%. Reports to Alec Kraft, VP of Sales

  • Travel: Occasional for enterprise customers

Your mission

Build the next digital generation of Storage24

Storage24 is the European leader in XXL self-storage and flexible space solutions. After rapid expansion, we are now building a data-driven, scalable digital platform.

We're looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer who thrives with high autonomy, takes ownership without being told twice, and delivers real impact — someone who's built things in a vibrant, fast-moving, ideally startup environment and knows how to figure things out when the path isn't fully mapped out yet.

- You take senior-level ownership end-to-end, and you don't wait around for instructions to get started

jobs.description:
Intro

Willkommen bei Sanoptis – einem führenden Netzwerk moderner Augenkliniken und augenärztlicher Praxen mit über 480 Standorten in ganz Europa. Unsere Vision ist es, Wohlbefinden und Lebensqualität durch erstklassige augenärztliche Behandlung zu verbessern. Unser innovatives, dezentrales Modell ermöglicht es unseren Partnerstandorten, unabhängig zu operieren und sich auf die individuellen Bedürfnisse ihrer Patienten zu konzentrieren. Gleichzeitig sind sie Teil eines größeren Netzwerks mit starken Partnern, das ihnen Synergieeffekte, modernste Technik und viele weitere Vorteile bietet.

Du bist ein Talent-Experte und weißt, wie eine Arbeitgebermarke repräsentativ zu etablieren ist und die besten Talente zu gewinnen sind?

In unserem People-Team bist Du für den gesamten Rekrutierungsprozess der Sanoptis-Gruppe verantwortlich. Du steuerst die Besetzung unserer offenen Stellen in 6 europäischen Ländern (DACH, Spanien, Italien, Griechenland). Du entwickelst und etablierst Best Practices, um die Standardisierung zu erhöhen und Synergien innerhalb unseres Netzwerks zu nutzen. Gemeinsam mit uns etablierst Du Sanoptis als den Employer-of-Choice am Markt.

Die Position ist zunächst als Elternzeitvertretung auf 18 Monate befristet.


In dieser Rolle wirst Du

  • Unsere Recruiting-Prozesse entwerfen und steuern: Du trägst die Verantwortung für alle Rekrutierungsaktivitäten der Sanoptis-Gruppe, einschließlich Stellenbeschreibungen, Kanalplanung, Active Sourcing, Bewerberauswahl und Durchführung von Erstgesprächen.
  • Unsere Metriken im Blick behalten und auswerten: Du wirst unsere KPI-Dashboards zur Überwachung der Leistung von Rekrutierungsaktivitäten steuern, auswerten und daraus Daten und evidenzbasierte Handlungen ableiten.
  • Unsere Recruitment-Partner intern und extern steuern: Du wirst Partner wie Stellenportale, Headhunter oder Personalagenturen steuern, Verträge prüfen und Preise verhandeln, um uns stets den besten Zugang zu Talenten zu sichern. Dabei steuerst Du auch Rekrutierungskampagnen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Marketingteam. Zusätzlich schulst Du die Personalverantwortlichen der Kliniken zur Verbesserung ihrer Recruitingaktivitäten.
  • Recruiting mit KI weiterentwickeln: Du beobachtest relevante KI-Trends und nutzt Claude gezielt, um Recruiting-Prozesse zu automatisieren und zu optimieren sowie KI-basierte Projekte eigenständig voranzutreiben.
  • Unsere Employer-Brand-Strategie umsetzen: Du stärkst die Sanoptis Employer Brand und entwickelst unsere Außenauftrittem, insbesondere auf LinkedIn, kununu und weiteren relevanten Plattformen, kontinuierlich weiter.


Du wirst zusammenarbeiten mit

  • Der Head of People Angelina Budes als Deine Führungskraft.
  • Dem globalen People-Team, welches in Recruiting, L&D und People Business Partnering unterteilt ist.
  • Entscheidungsträgern wie Head-ofs, C-Level Executives und Hiring Managern, wenn es um die Einstellung der besten Talente geht.
  • Vielen weiteren Stakeholdern im gesamten Unternehmen durch Hiring-Prozesse, Trainings und weitere Recruiting-Maßnahmen, die Du leitest.


Dein Profil überzeugt durch

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Recruiting oder Personalwesen.
  • Erfahrung im internationalen Stakeholder-Management. Idealerweise hast Du bereits in einem Private-Equity-Umfeld gearbeitet.
  • Affinität zu KI-Anwendungen, insbesondere Claude; praktische Erfahrung mit KI-gestützten Recruiting-Prozessen und -Projekten ist ein Plus.
  • Erfahrung mit ATS-Systemen (z.B. Personio).
  • Ausgeprägte analytische, konzeptionelle und strategische Fähigkeiten und idealerweise Erfahrung im Projektmanagement.
  • Emotionale Intelligenz sowie hervorragende zwischenmenschliche und kommunikative Fähigkeiten.
  • Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau sowie Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau.


Sanoptis bietet Dir

  • Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung: Ein äußerst wettbewerbsfähiges Gehaltspaket, ergänzt durch einen jährlichen leistungsabhängigen Bonus, der an individuelle und unternehmensspezifische Ziele gebunden ist.
  • Eigenständigkeit und kreative Freiheit: Die Möglichkeit, selbstständig zu arbeiten und sich mit innovativen Ideen einzubringen, dank flacher Hierarchien und kurzer Entscheidungswege, was unsere Organisation stärkt.

Deine Karriere

Wir suchen erfahrene AI Engineers, die KI nicht nur demonstrieren, sondern produktiv bekommen – als Teil komplexer Business-Anwendungen, die im Alltag unserer Kunden tragen müssen. Du bist Softwareentwickler mit echter Engineering-Tiefe, idealerweise mit Full-Stack-Erfahrung, und du bewegst dich sicher in Cloud-Umgebungen wie AWS und/oder Azure. Du denkst LLMs, Agenten und datengetriebene Services von Anfang an mit – und weißt, wo sie fachlich sinnvoll sind und wo nicht.

Ein Schwerpunkt liegt für uns im Agentic Engineering: Systeme, die nicht nur antworten, sondern handeln – mit Tool-Zugriff, mehrstufigen Abläufen, Zustand, Fehlerbehandlung und klar definierten Grenzen. Genau hier trennt sich der Prototyp von der Lösung, die man einem Kunden guten Gewissens übergibt. Und genau hier brauchen wir Leute, die beides können: Modelle verstehen und robuste Software bauen.

Wichtig ist uns: Diese Rolle bleibt hands-on. Du baust selbst, du deployst selbst, du debuggst selbst. 

Bei nerdware steht nicht nur der Code im Mittelpunkt, sondern vor allem der Mensch dahinter. Die beste technische Lösung entsteht dort, wo Teamgeist, offene Kommunikation und gegenseitiges Vertrauen gelebt werden. Wenn du menschlich zu uns passt, hast du den wichtigsten Schritt bereits gemacht.

Wir arbeiten in einem Feld, das sich schneller verändert als jedes andere in der Softwareentwicklung. Deshalb suchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, neugierig bleiben und Hype von Substanz unterscheiden können. Eigeninitiative, technischer Weitblick und die Freude daran, gemeinsam Lösungen zu entwickeln, sind uns genauso wichtig wie ein respektvoller und wertschätzender Umgang im Team.

  • Agentic Engineering: Entwurf und Umsetzung agentischer Systeme – Tool- und Function-Calling, Orchestrierung mehrstufiger Workflows, Kontext- und State-Management, Retries und Fallbacks, Human-in-the-Loop und sinnvolle Guardrails

  • Aktive Mitgestaltung unseres wachsenden KI-Kompetenzfelds – Themen setzen, Wissen ins Team tragen, Standards etablieren

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit LLMs und generativer KI in echten Projekten: Prompting, RAG, Embeddings/Vektor-Datenbanken, Function Calling, Fine-Tuning oder Agenten-Frameworks. 
  • Erfahrung oder ernsthaftes Interesse an Agentic Engineering – du hast schon einmal einen Agenten über den Demo-Status hinaus gebracht oder brennst darauf, es zu tun
  • Solides Verständnis von ML-Grundlagen und Datenverarbeitung – du weißt, was ein Modell leisten kann und wo seine Grenzen liegen
  • Cloud-Entwicklung mit AWS und/oder Azure, inklusive CI/CD, Containern und Infrastructure as Code
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Clean Code, SOLID-Prinzipien und der Gestaltung sauberer Softwarearchitekturen
  • Selbstständige, verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise mit stark ausgeprägten analytischen und konzeptionellen Fähigkeiten
  • Die Fähigkeit, pragmatische Lösungen für komplexe Anforderungen zu entwickeln – und über den Tellerrand hinaus zu denken
  • Hohe Motivation und Leidenschaft für Softwareentwicklung und für ein Technologiefeld, das sich monatlich neu erfindet

Billing Manager

Permanent employee · Full-time · Berlin (HQ)


Our Mission For You
Own the invoicing engine of a hyper-growth energy-tech company. Your work directly protects our cash flow and keeps our growth engine running. Invoicing directly affects our cash flow in the millions. This role is a lever, not a cost center.

trawa enables mid-sized companies to access green, intelligent energy. We're a hyper-growth company with strong team growth, rising invoice volumes, and increasing complexity per invoice. Individual contracts, PPAs, spot, futures, EEG direct marketing, grid fees, taxes: every customer segment is a small puzzle. Today, that puzzle is solved mostly manually, and it needs to move to the next level.

You'll build order out of that complexity. You'll jump into individual invoices when it matters. At the same time, you'll design the process that makes those individual jumps unnecessary. You'll be part of our Billing Tool Rollout and help prepare invoicing for our ERP migration. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to own the operation, not just manage it.


What You'll Own

Own Invoicing End to End

  • Own daily invoicing processes to trawa customers: quality, completeness, timing

  • Reduce and eliminate our current ticket backlog through prioritization, root-cause analysis, and systematic execution

  • Ensure complex billing logic (PPA, spot, futures, EEG direct marketing, grid fees, taxes) is correctly reflected in every invoice

  • Own the invoicing KPIs: on-time rate, error rate, ticket aging, time-to-invoice

Build Scalable Processes

  • Be part of designing and rolling out a scalable invoicing architecture, from today's manual setup to a standardized and automated solution

  • Automate recurring process steps

  • Document everything: reproducible, hand-off-ready, audit-ready

  • Direct customer communication on invoicing questions, in writing (German and English)

  • Partner closely with Sales and Customer Success to secure upstream data quality (contracts, prices, delivery points)

  • Partner closely with our Tech/Data team, where consumption data, time series, and energy accruals are your input

  • Establish escalation paths and priority logic with Sales and CS, so edge cases don't block the standard process

Data Quality & Handover to Accounting

  • Ensure invoicing data flows cleanly into accounting, as the interface to our accounting team

  • Contribute to month-end close: clean invoicing cut-off, documented open items, accruals-relevant data ready on time

  • Audit-readiness from an invoicing perspective: process documentation, invoice-level traceability, controls


Who You Are

Must-haves

  • 3+ years in Billing, Order-to-Cash, Finance Operations, or similar operational Finance roles

  • Scale-up experience, with at least one station at a fast-growing company. You've worked without a clean ERP, with ambiguous processes, in a team being built as it runs

  • B2B billing with complex pricing models, not SaaS flat-rate. You've handled individual contracts, volume-based logic, or formula-driven pricing

  • Proven high-output track record. You've personally delivered and you can point to a moment where you built or saved a critical process

  • Systems thinker with a detail obsession. You see the pattern behind ticket or invoice corrections

  • Excel/ Sheets power user. You build models others can't unpack, and you document them so they can

Month 1: Land & Understand

  • Understand our business model, the German energy market basics, and our billing complexity. Understand what drives our corrections rate. Build relationships with the most important stakeholders.

Month 2: Stabilize

  • Keep invoicing running stably while spotting optimization opportunities. Define clear ticket priorities and escalation paths with Sales and CS. Ship first quick wins in automation and process design. Define and start tracking your KPIs: error rate, ticket aging.

Month 3: Build

  • Deliver a target process architecture for improvements to our current invoicing processes. Actively and proactively reduce time-to-invoice and corrections rates. Present your automation and process roadmap to the finance leadership team.

Why trawa?

  • Real ownership from day one. You build the invoicing function that unlocks trawa's growth

ABOUT US

We are reshaping the global secondary metals industry to accelerate the circular flow of metals. You’ll work directly with teams to understand their data needs, dig into the details hands-on, and find the right way to answer their questions - whether through SQL, Excel, dashboards, or other tools. You’ll also translate recurring needs into requirements for Engineering and help build stable, automated reporting and analytics over time, particularly across our trading business.
Join our international team and play a key role in shaping innovative solutions for scrap metal processing - using data and technology to build a more efficient and sustainable future.


YOUR MISSION

METYCLE - where innovation meets sustainability

We are building the B2B online platform to accelerate the global circular flow of secondary metals. READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

If you are passionate about industrial automation, solving complex technical challenges, and building something from the ground up, join our team as an Industrial Automation Engineer.

The machinery is the easy part to buy. The control system that turns it into a plant - and the standards, documentation, and data that keep it running - is what we are hiring you to own.

We are looking for an experienced Industrial Automation Engineer to take ownership of our plant’s control systems from design through commissioning and into stable production. You bring deep hands-on experience in programming and commissioning industrial control systems and are comfortable taking responsibility for the PLC, safety systems, HMI, industrial networking, and interfaces between multiple machine suppliers.

Beyond programming, you understand what it takes to make a plant genuinely reliable in production and have the technical confidence to hold suppliers to high professional standards. Join our international team, help build innovative solutions for scrap metal processing, and contribute to a more sustainable future.

  • Plant Availability: Design stop and interlock behaviour to minimise unnecessary downtime — allowing unaffected parts of the plant to keep running when it is safe to do so. Plant availability is a direct business outcome here, and you will directly influence it
  • Machine Safety: Implement the machine-safety control concept on a fail-safe F-CPU with F-I/O, including the hardwired e-stop loop, PLC-enforced zone isolation that cannot be overridden, guard interlocks, and controlled, sequenced shutdown
  • Safety & Compliance: Be our in-house technical counterpart on EN ISO 13849 performance-level determination and the CE file, working with external assessors while retaining ownership of the technical approach and decisions
  • Machine Integration: Integrate control systems from several different machine suppliers into one coherent line, so that a single stop is genuinely a single stop across the whole plant
  • Supplier Management: Hold machine builders and panel builders to specification, including unlocked code, complete documentation, and standards compliance
  • OT / IT & Industrial IoT: Get plant data out over OPC UA / MQTT / Modbus TCP into our own systems, so stoppage reasons, energy use, and throughput become actionable data. Work closely with our Industrial IoT team, who own the edge and data side of that boundary

  • Comfortable reading electrical schematics and troubleshooting cabinets, hardware, signals, wiring, and control behaviour directly on the shop floor. You have brought at least one production line from commissioning into stable production; maintenance-only experience is not sufficient

This role is particularly suited to someone who has already experienced a fast-growth environment, whether in a start-up, scale-up or during a 0-to-100 journey.

  • Fluent English (written and spoken) to interact with the Alan team

  • Based in Paris or the Île-de-France region, with the ability to work onsite regularly, ideally three days per week or more.

Ideally:

  • Experience in MedTech or in a start-up / scale-up

  • Sensitivity to the medical world (professional or personal)

  • Note: a 100% Occupational Health background may not be the right cultural fit, but worth testing

🙏 What we offer

  • Location: 117 Quai de Valmy, Paris 10th, in a brand-new centre designed to support high-quality practice

  • Base salary: between €53,000 and €61,000 gross per year, depending on experience and level

  • Profit-sharing scheme: 10%, in line with Prévenir’s framework

jobs.description:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS

 

Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.

 

Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).

 

Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).

 

VOTRE RÔLE

Au sein du pôle Développement Maroquinerie, le/la Chef(fe) de produit est garant(e), du développement des produits et du suivi des collections. En lien direct avec la Responsable Développement Maroquinerie, il/elle intervient de manière autonome sur l'ensemble de son périmètre, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes, Création Produit, Merchandising et Production.

 

VOS MISSIONS  

  • Travail en autonomie sur les offres maroquinerie homme, petite maroquinerie, ceintures et projets VIP
  • Accompagnement des fabricants dans le développement des produits, sur la base du brief du studio et du brief merchandising, déplacements sur site à prévoir
  • Gestion du parc de fabricants en collaboration avec l’équipe production (identification des forces et faiblesses, contretype)
  • Propositions d’alternatives techniques auprès du studio et des fabricants, pour anticiper les problématiques industrialisation et costing dans le respect de l’intention créative
  • Pilotage du développement des prototypes et des échantillons dans le respect des délais, de la marge et du niveau de qualité
  • Visibilité prix tout au long de la collection et négociations dans le respect des objectifs de marge
  • En charge du référencements produits et garant de l’exactitude des nomenclatures produits
  • Mise à jour des plans de collection et outils de suivi de collections
  • Support argumentaires spécificités produits pour l’équipe merchandising
  • Gestion planning shooting packshot et conformité produit en lien avec l’équipe image
  • Participation aux organisations défilé (pointage collection, mises en place produit pour editing styling et fitting, packing collection)
  • Préparation et transmission des dossiers techniques aux équipes industrialisation et production.
  • Validations facture et suivi rigoureux des coûts engagés
  • Participation à l’amélioration en continue des process

 

VOTRE PROFIL

  • Bac +3 à Bac +5 (commerce, mode ou équivalent), avec 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en développement produit maroquinerie et/ou petite maroquinerie, idéalement dans l'univers du luxe ou de la mode

 

  • Bonne connaissance du marché et de ses acteurs

 

  • Expérience en gestion fabricants, développement produits et analyse de dossiers techniques

 

  • Maîtrise d'Excel et des outils bureautiques ; connaissance d'un ERP/PLM fortement appréciée

 

  • Anglais professionnel indispensable, italien fortement apprécié

 

  • Forte sensibilité produit alliée à une organisation rigoureuse et un bon sens des priorités

 

  • Aisance relationnelle, esprit d'équipe, proactivité, flexibilité et sens des responsabilités

Everfield les épaule sur le recrutement et les RH, et leur donne accès à une équipe d'experts qui les conseille sur les aspects financiers et opérationnels de la construction et de la croissance des entreprises B2B SaaS européennes. Fondé en 2022, Everfield est déjà présent dans 7 pays, et continue de se développer.

Rôle

En tant que Gestionnaire RH & Paie, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans le bon fonctionnement des opérations RH au sein des sociétés du portefeuille. En étroite collaboration avec l'équipe HR Business Partnering, vous gérerez l'administration RH, coordonnerez la paie et fournirez des données et rapports précis pour appuyer la prise de décision. Vous serez le premier point de contact pour les questions RH quotidiennes des collaborateurs, en garantissant un support RH rapide, précis et conforme. Ce rôle constitue le socle d'une gestion RH efficace, permettant aux dirigeants et aux HRBP de se concentrer sur les priorités stratégiques.

Responsabilités clés (liste non exhaustive)

  • Administration RH : gérer le cycle de vie des collaborateurs, y compris l'intégration, les départs et la gestion des absences. Rédiger et émettre les contrats de travail et leurs avenants, tenir à jour le SIRH, et administrer les avantages sociaux et régimes de retraite de l'entreprise.

  • Paie : préparer, traiter et valider la paie mensuelle des sociétés du portefeuille, en liaison avec le prestataire de paie externe. Garantir l'exactitude et le respect des délais.

  • Opérations RH : être le premier point de contact pour les questions des collaborateurs. Contribuer à la mise à jour des politiques et veiller au respect des exigences légales locales en matière de droit du travail.

  • Support HRBP & CoE : contribuer à la préparation des dossiers d'intégration, de la documentation disciplinaire, des enquêtes de départ, et des tâches RH opérationnelles. Apporter un soutien aux équipes CoE dans le déploiement de programmes.

  • Expérience préalable en administration RH ou dans un poste RH opérationnel similaire, appréciée.

jobs.title: AIT MGSE Engineer - Lunar Lander
jobs.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.


As part of this initiative, we are developing a lunar lander capable of precision landing and reusable operations. To support this effort, we are establishing a dedicated remote test site in the United Arab Emirates to perform hot-fire propulsion testing and hopper flight demonstrations.

We want you as a talented AIT MGSE Engineer to help us in our mission by designing and delivering the MGSEs needed for the preparation and testing of our Lunar Lander.

Key Responsibilities

In your capacity as AIT MGSE Engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day duties will include:

  • Work closely with Engineering and AIT colleagues to understand and refine the requirements/timelines for the different MGSEs that we will need for various assembly or testing activities.

  • Conceptualise, design (CAD including manufacturing drawings), procure and commission the MGSEs.

  • Confirm with mechanical analysis/hand calculations/proof tests that the design is compatible with the external loads.

  • Discuss with suppliers the MGSE designs for ease of manufacturing and with the most adequate processes.

  • Follow up the manufacturing/procurement with the suppliers (with the support of our supply chain team) and answer any technical questions/concerns ensuring timely delivery of all items.

  • Provide necessary instructions and support the assembly / commissioning / implementation of these MGSEs.

What we would love to see from you

In the role of AIT MGSE Engineer ideally, you will have the following:

  • Mechanical / Aerospace engineering degree or similar with focus on machine / structural design.

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in CAD design + drafting (using Siemens NX or similar) and FE analysis (using Hypermesh or similar).

  • Good understanding of machine design and different manufacturing processes (e.g. machining, welding, etc), design for manufacturing and GD&T.

  • Familiarity with standard margin calculation methodologies for various applications like beam design, bolted joints, welds, etc.

  • Experience with planning/execution of mechanical tests in-house would be a plus.

  • Good at documentation including design descriptions, assembly instructions, test reports, etc.

  • Creative with innovative ideas and technical problem solving/troubleshooting skills.

  • Basic hands-on experience with mechanical assembly and simple machining tools like drilling machine.

  • Previous experience in space AIT and MGSE design would be highly appreciated.

  • Good English communication skills (French would be a plus).

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Engineer - North America
jobs.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

As a Sales Engineer, it’s your mission to show the value of Camunda and guide organizations planning to automate their core business processes.

You accompany prospective customers in their product evaluation of Camunda. You are responsible for achieving the product win, getting answers to all product related technical questions, and arranging all presales interactions driving the evaluation.

In this role you will partner with our Account Executives and Solution Architects, supporting you by conducting proof of concepts or handling other deeply technical discussions. You will help qualify opportunities and then help set and execute a sales strategy to achieve a win.

The effectiveness of Camunda's Sales Engineers is gauged by their ability to convert prospects into Camunda customers both efficiently and at a high rate.

This position requires a strong interest in cutting-edge software technologies. You should take pleasure in crafting sample code or custom demonstrations and exploring new technology, even if you're not highly experienced in software development. By empathizing with prospects, you better grasp their requirements and have engaging technical conversations, and excel at clarifying how Camunda's technology can benefit their business.

What you'll be doing:

In this role you will:

  • Map customer requirements to our Camunda product portfolio

  • Position potential quantitative and qualitative business value of Camunda

  • Develop individual Camunda evaluation plans and demos for our prospects

  • Conduct product demos and product related Q&A sessions

  • Support the completion of RFI / RFP documents

  • Team with Account Executives to develop accounts

  • Organize and execute pre-sales engagements

  • Implement code snippets

  • Create and maintain pre-sales content and technical artifacts

What you bring:

  1. Strong Technical Foundation:
     A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience. Solid understanding of programming fundamentals, modern software engineering practices, and common IT/system architectures.

  2. Proven Sales Engineering Experience:
     Experience in Sales Engineering or Pre-Sales, with a deep understanding of sales cycles, value-based selling, and stakeholder engagement. Skilled in handling objections and driving deals to closure in a consultative selling environment.

  3. Communication Excellence:
     Exceptional presentation and interpersonal skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives tailored to technical and non-technical audiences alike.

  4. Language Proficiency:
     Fluent in English (C1/C2 level or native proficiency)

  5. Travel Flexibility:
     Willingness to travel occasionally for customer meetings, events, and team collaboration.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience in enterprise automation, business process management (BPM), process orchestration, robotic process automation (RPA), Agentic-AI or similar domains.

  • Familiarity with value-based selling, including conducting value workshops and applying value engineering frameworks.

  • Strong understanding of the process automation and orchestration product landscape and key industry players.

  • Industry experience in BFSI, Telecommunications, or Logistics.

À propos d'ILLUIN Technology

ILLUIN Technology est le leader français de l'IA Générative souveraine et de confiance. Nous développons des modèles de langage (LLM) propriétaires et une plateforme technologique de pointe pour permettre aux entreprises et aux organisations de déployer l'IA générative en toute sécurité, en gardant la maîtrise de leurs données.

Adossé au fond privé Seven2, Illuin est entré dans une phase d’investissement et de forte croissance depuis le début de l’année. Dans ce contexte d’accélération, le Groupe recrute un/une Chargé(e) d’Administration RH afin de sécuriser et de professionnaliser l’ensemble des processus administratifs liés au cycle de paie et à l’expérience interne des Illuiners.

Votre Mission

Rattaché(e) directement à la Direction Administratif et Financier, en lien étroit avec les équipes opérationnelles, vous êtes le/la garant(e) du contrôle interne de la paie et de la fiabilité des données sociales. La paie est externalisée auprès d’un prestataire : votre rôle n’est pas de la produire mais d’en assurer la préparation, le contrôle et la coordination de bout en bout.

Vous évoluerez dans un environnement dynamique et agile, dans un contexte de structuration où vous devrez faire preuve de rigueur, de polyvalence et être force de proposition afin de contribuer à l’avancement d’un vaste panel de missions tels que :

  • Pilotage et contrôle de la paie externalisée

    • Collecte, consolidation et transmission des éléments variables de paie au prestataire (entrées/sorties, absences, variables, primes, notes de frais impactant la paie) selon un calendrier de paie maîtrisé ;

    • Contrôle de la saisie des temps par les salariés (suivi des congés etc) ;

    • Collecte des déclarations sociales produites par le prestataire (DSN, charges sociales, organismes de prévoyance et de mutuelle) et suivi des éventuelles anomalies jusqu’à résolution ;

    • Rapprochement de la paie avec la comptabilité en lien avec le CFO et l’expert comptable (écritures de paie, provisions congés payés, comptes de tiers sociaux).

  • Administration du personnel et cycle de vie collaborateur

    • Gestion administrative des entrées : DPAE, rédaction des contrats et avenants, affiliations mutuelle et prévoyance, visites médicales, création des dossiers collaborateurs ;

    • Suivi des évolutions en cours de vie (avenants, mobilités, changements de temps de travail) et des sorties (documents de fin de contrat, coordination avec la paie et le management) ;

    • Suivi des absences, congés, arrêts de travail, IJSS et dossiers de prévoyance ;

    • Gestion des dispositifs collectifs et avantages (titres-restaurant, mutuelle, mobilité durable, remboursements transport) ;

    • Tenue et fiabilisation des obligations administratives : registre unique du personnel, affichages, archivage et conformité RGPD des données sociales.

  • Coordination des prestataires et interlocuteurs externes

    • Interlocuteur(trice) de référence du cabinet de paie : animation du rythme de collaboration, cadrage des livrables, respect des échéances et arbitrage des points bloquants ;

    • Point de contact avec les organismes externes (URSSAF, organismes de retraite et de prévoyance, médecine du travail, OPCO, mutuelle) en lien avec le prestataire et le CFO;

  • Data & Process Owner RH

    • Élaboration et documentation de l’ensemble des processus administratifs RH et de l’outillage associé (SIRH), dans un contexte de croissance et avec la perspective d’intégration de nouvelles entités ;

    • Garantie de la qualité et de la cohérence de la donnée sociale entre le SIRH, la paie et les outils Finance.

  • Conformité sociale et missions ponctuelles

    • Veille sur la réglementation sociale et l’application de la convention collective, avec appui de conseils externes sur les sujets complexes ;

    • Contribution aux obligations et échéances annuelles (index égalité professionnelle, déclarations obligatoires, préparation des audits) ;

    • Participation aux projets de structuration de la fonction People : déploiement ou évolution du SIRH, automatisation des processus, préparation des instances représentatives du personnel.

Profil Recherché

Il s’agit d’un poste évolutif, à la fois du fait de la croissance et de l’ambition du Groupe mais aussi de la variété des chantiers rencontrés laissant ainsi la place à l’expression des appétences de chacun.

  • Formation en Ressources Humaines, gestion de la paie ou droit social (Licence/Master, titre professionnel gestionnaire de paie)

  • Une expérience confirmée en administration du personnel et en gestion ou contrôle de la paie, en entreprise ou en cabinet

  • Bonne connaissance des mécanismes de paie et du cadre légal et conventionnel français ; une connaissance de la convention Syntec est un plus

  • Notions et curiosité appréciées sur les outils SIRH, l’automatisation des processus et l'A appliquée aux fonctions support

Nous recherchons un profil autonome et force de proposition faisant preuve d’une grande rigueur et d’un sens aigu de la confidentialité. Vous devrez faire preuve de curiosité, de polyvalence et d’une capacité d’adaptation pour évoluer sur plusieurs sujets de front demandant un regard critique, ainsi que d’un vrai sens du service auprès des collaborateurs.

Ce que propose le poste

  • Un rôle central et à forte visibilité, au contact de l’ensemble des collaborateurs et en lien direct avec la Direction,

  • Un périmètre complet, de la paie à l’administration du personnel,

  • La possibilité de construire son propre périmètre et sa fonction de zéro, en proposant les outils et les processus qui structureront la fonction People.

Audit et analyse des besoins fonctionnels

  • Être le relais d'information vers le PSS Back, en charge de l'intégration, de la correction et du contrôle

  • Collaborer avec les équipes PSS Back sur le débogage et la résolution des problèmes métiers après migration

  • Conduire des tests fonctionnels intermédiaires et finaux pour valider les solutions

  • Contribuer aux rapports post-migration et proposer des axes d'amélioration

Automatisation et optimisation des processus

  • Identifier et prioriser les besoins en automatisation et en optimisation

  • Participer à leur mise en œuvre via de la documentation, des feedbacks ou des propositions concrètes

  • Suivre la satisfaction métier après chaque évolution

Veille, R&D et amélioration continue

  • Assurer une veille produit et métier pour garantir la pertinence des fonctionnalités

  • Proposer des améliorations sur l'existant et signaler les manques ou dysfonctionnements

  • Contribuer à la transformation des besoins en solutions actionnables, pour l'interne comme pour l'externe

Collaboration Front / Back

  • Connaître les enjeux des tâches du PSS Back et pouvoir intervenir ponctuellement sur la production selon les besoins

  • Formation comptable : IUT GEA, BTS CGO, DCG, DSCG, Master CCA — tu as les bases solides

  • Envie d'apprendre en continu et de rester à jour sur les évolutions fonctionnelles de Pennylane

  • Anglais niveau A2 minimum

Les "nice to have"

  2. Un entretien avec un Team Leader PSS — pour rentrer dans le fond du poste

  3. Un cas pratique avec un Partner Solutions Specialist — pour voir comment tu travailles concrètement

jobs.title: Senior SEO & Organic Growth Strategist
jobs.description:
Ready to shape the future of B2B SaaS SEO while working with some of the fastest-growing companies in tech?

If you're equally passionate about driving strategic SEO initiatives and building strong senior client relationships, we want to talk to you.

We're looking for an SEO Strategist who can lead client conversations, turn SEO complexity into clear business recommendations, and confidently explain what matters, why it matters, and what should happen next.

Our Mission at Powered by Search

We exist to make B2B SaaS companies unstoppable.

We're on a mission to be the best in the world at SaaS marketing — doing work we love, with people we like, how we want.

The Opportunity

As a trusted advisor to fast-growing B2B SaaS companies, you'll join an elite team rated 5/5 ★★★★★ on Glassdoor, where 99% of team members recommend us to their peers.

This is a client-facing strategic SEO role. You won’t just be auditing websites or creating recommendations in isolation. You’ll be expected to lead conversations, explain tradeoffs, guide clients toward decisions, and connect SEO work to business outcomes.

You'll have the freedom to:

  • Drive holistic SEO strategies that deliver measurable business impact
  • Build strong, strategic relationships with SaaS marketing leaders
  • Shape the future of SEO in an AI-first search landscape
  • Work with a team that values strategic thinking as much as technical expertise
  • Own client outcomes through clear strategy, communication, and follow-through

What Sets You Apart

You're an ideal fit if you:

  • Can lead senior client conversations with clarity, confidence, and commercial judgment
  • Translate technical SEO insights into plain-English business recommendations
  • Connect SEO initiatives to pipeline, revenue, retention, and client priorities
  • Build trust with clients by communicating clearly, proactively, and directly
  • Get energized by analyzing data and uncovering actionable insights
  • Know how to turn messy SEO data into a clear story and next steps
  • Are comfortable challenging assumptions, clarifying tradeoffs, and guiding clients toward decisions
  • Love staying ahead of emerging SEO trends, especially in AI and semantic search
  • Embrace our core values:
    • Give a Sh!t
    • Always Be in It To Win It
    • Be Obsessed with Serving Others
    • Practice a Growth Mindset
    • When We Fail, We Don't Lose the Lesson

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership — 40%

  • Develop comprehensive SEO strategies aligned with B2B SaaS business goals
  • Lead strategic client communications, monthly/quarterly reviews, and senior stakeholder conversations
  • Create and present clear performance narratives that explain results, tradeoffs, risks, and next actions
  • Turn data, rankings, traffic, pipeline, and conversion signals into practical SEO recommendations
  • Push client conversations toward decisions, priorities, and committed next steps
  • Drive innovation in AI-enhanced SEO strategies

Client Success — 40%

  • Manage and grow a portfolio of 3–5 B2B SaaS clients
  • Build trust with senior marketing, demand generation, product marketing, and executive stakeholders
  • Lead strategic planning sessions, performance reviews, and client calls with confidence
  • Proactively identify risks, opportunities, blockers, and next steps before the client has to ask
  • Own follow-through by making sure client conversations end with clear actions, owners, and timelines
  • Communicate progress, risks, and recommendations in a way clients can understand and act on

Technical Excellence — 20%

  • Guide technical SEO implementation and optimization
  • Identify technical, content, and authority-building opportunities that can improve organic performance
  • Develop and optimize conversion-focused SEO funnels
  • Integrate GA4, GTM, and reporting tools to generate useful performance insights
  • Recommend and guide advanced schema markup strategies
  • Prioritize SEO recommendations based on business impact, effort, and implementation realities

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of SEO experience, with at least 2 year focused on B2B SaaS
  • Previous experience in a client-facing SEO strategy role where you owned client communication, not just execution
  • Proven track record of driving organic growth for B2B or enterprise clients
  • Strong portfolio of successful client relationships and retention
  • Deep understanding of technical SEO, content strategy, analytics, and SEO performance measurement
  • Experience with GA4, GTM, and modern SEO tools
  • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to lead client calls, explain SEO recommendations clearly, and write concise client-ready updates
  • Strong judgment in prioritizing SEO work based on business impact, client context, and implementation realities
  • Ability to present performance, risks, opportunities, and next steps clearly to senior stakeholders

This Role May Not Be a Fit If

  • You prefer doing SEO execution without leading client conversations
  • You struggle to explain SEO concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • You need someone else to turn your analysis into client-ready recommendations
  • You are uncomfortable challenging assumptions, clarifying tradeoffs, or guiding senior clients toward decisions
  • Your written or spoken English is not strong enough for live client-facing strategy conversations
  • You prefer being handed tasks rather than owning outcomes, priorities, and client follow-through

Why Join Us?

  • Work with a team that values strategic thinking and innovation
  • Competitive base salary plus quarterly performance bonuses
  • 5 weeks of paid time off
  • Fully remote work environment with flexible hours — you just need at least 4 hours of daily overlap with North American time zones
  • Comprehensive health spending account and eye/dental/medical benefits for Canadian residents
  • Regular team meetups and annual retreats
  • Clear career progression path without requiring a management track
  • Exposure to industry-leading B2B SaaS companies
  • Weekly 1:1 coaching with experienced managers
  • Access to proven playbooks, frameworks, and professional development opportunities

What Future Co-Workers Say

Here are some comments from your future co-workers about their experience at Powered by Search:

One of my life's best decisions was to join PBS. Here's why:

  • Working with top 1% SaaS experts
  • Supportive and empathetic leadership
  • End-to-end control with no account manager involvement
  • Highly data-driven and results-oriented
  • Remote-first with a supportive global team and flexible work hours
  • Your growth here in 1 year is similar to 3 to 4 years in other companies

Your Growth Journey

We believe in building our people so they can build the business.

You'll receive:

  • Weekly 1:1 coaching with experienced managers
  • Access to our proven playbooks and frameworks
  • Regular professional development opportunities
  • Exposure to industry-leading B2B SaaS companies
  • Clear feedback on how to grow as a strategist, communicator, and client leader

Ready to Help Make B2B SaaS Companies Unstoppable?

If you can combine SEO expertise, business judgment, and clear client communication, we’d love to hear from you.

  • You lead senior client conversations with clarity, confidence, and commercial judgment

Key responsibilities

Client Success

Technical Excellence

  • Diagnose performance issues at the root: tracking, structure, bidding, creative, or demand
  • Prioritize by business impact, effort, and implementation reality; QA everything before it ships

Required experience

jobs.description:
About Clipboard

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.


Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

About the Role

The Account Manager will be instrumental in helping grow and retain Clipboard's existing markets. Healthcare providers are core to the Clipboard marketplace — the Account Manager is in charge of nurturing and expanding relationships with current users, going deep with those users to understand their needs, and ensuring they're consistently successful on the platform. There's no ceiling to what you can achieve in this role — if you're highly motivated to go above and beyond, a diligent executor, and a strong written/verbal communicator, Clipboard is the place for you to excel.

Responsibilities

  • Managing and growing relationships with an existing portfolio of healthcare providers and dental offices

  • Clearly articulating the value proposition of the app to current users to drive continued engagement and expansion

  • Going deep with healthcare providers and dental offices to uncover their evolving needs, understand their challenges, and find ways to genuinely help them succeed on the platform

  • Establishing credibility and rapport with providers, which includes demonstrating a strong understanding of the app

  • Being the go-to point of contact for users that need help navigating the app, resolving issues, and getting the most out of the platform

  • Helping fill new and urgent shifts in your assigned markets

Qualifications

  • Willingness to hustle / lack of fear

  • Experience texting, emailing, and talking with English-speaking clients and prospects

Requirements

  • Stable high-speed internet connection

  • A computer workstation (laptop or desktop)

  • Internationally located (not in US, CA, UK, NZ, or AU)

  • Availability to work US working hours

  • Fluency in English speaking and writing

Beyond the Basics — What Will Make You Successful

  • Noticing & Curiosity — You pick up on things others miss and ask "why" more than once because the first answer is rarely the whole story. You dig to understand the root of a problem or situation rather than accepting things at face value, and you're constantly updating your understanding of the customers you serve.

  • Initiative & Persistence — You have a bias for action. You know that our customers are dealing with real problems today, and you don't wait for perfect information before making a move. You're scrappy and self-reliant, you find ways through obstacles rather than around them, and you bring solutions instead of asking "what should I do?"

  • Ownership — The buck stops with you, no matter what anyone else did or did not do. You take full responsibility for your results, fix problems when you see them — even outside your immediate area — and put processes in place to make sure those problems don't happen again.

  • Customer-Centric — You feel your customers' situations genuinely and care about improving their lives, not just hitting a number. Talking to customers and solving their problems isn't a task on your list — it's the job.

  • Humble — You're low ego and care about getting to the best outcome, not about being right. You readily admit when you don't know something, you actively seek out feedback, and you're always looking to become a better version of yourself.

Benefits

  • Do great work that matters for customers who could really use your help

  • Competitive pay

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Fully Remote

Estimated annual compensation: $12,000–$15,600 USD. Each candidate's compensation offer within this range will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, and geographic location.

Do you want to join the company behind Northern Europe’s largest crypto and stock market comparison platforms? Do you want to own the product roadmap end to end and build it yourself? Do you want to decide what we build next as we expand globally?

We’re looking for a hands-on Product Lead to join our small but driven 100% remote team. This is a rare hybrid role: roughly 60% product leadership (roadmap, prioritization, specs, analytics) and 40% full stack development. You’ll work alongside our full-stack web developer, and as we expand the Product Team, your focus will shift increasingly toward product and team leadership, running 1-on-1s, recruiting, and building your own team to improve our products, with a clear path toward Head of Product.

Who are Optimizee Group?

Optimizee Group has been delivering results for 450+ partners worldwide through financial comparison platforms since 2017. Our portfolio includes CryptoRunner.com (the largest cryptocurrency comparison platform in Northern Europe), InvestoRunner.com (the largest stock market comparison platform in Sweden), and CreditRunner.com (a new credit card comparison platform launching soon).

Our mission is to build the world’s biggest and most trusted portfolio of financial comparison platforms, helping millions of people make better financial decisions. To date, we’ve generated over 8 million views and delivered more than 1.8 million referrals to our partners. With approximately 44,000 monthly active users and 35,000+ subscribers, you’ll have a strong existing audience and foundation to build on.

In 2026, we relaunched our websites on fully custom-built platforms, replacing our previous WordPress setup (see full tech stack below). The new platforms are connected to our in-house admin system, with integrations to multiple AI models and third-party API providers, giving us greater flexibility, scalability, and control as we grow. AI is deeply integrated into the admin system and across development, content, and operations. Over the past year we’ve shipped 970+ updates, and our product backlog holds 350+ tasks. Your job: review our platforms and product backlog, decide what to prioritize, and turn ideas into new features — with direct support from the founder, a former web developer who built our first platforms line by line.

Why Join Optimizee Group:

  • Be Part of a Market Leader – Help shape our established platforms, our group includes the largest stock and crypto comparison platforms in Northern Europe.
  • Full Ownership, Real Impact – High autonomy, meaningful ownership, and the opportunity to influence company decisions.
  • Join Early, Grow Faster – Join a small, fast-growing team where your role, responsibilities, and opportunities grow alongside the company.
  • Join an Ambitious Team – Work alongside high-performing teammates who value ownership, continuous improvement, and long-term thinking.

Benefits:

  • 🚀 Clear path to Head of Product as the team scales
  • 🤝 Work directly with the founder on strategy and growth
  • ⏰ High autonomy, flexible working hours, and strong ownership
  • 📈 Competitive compensation package + performance-based bonus
  • 🌎 Fully remote role — work from most countries worldwide

  • 💻 Home office setup — laptop and required equipment provided
  • ✈️ Annual business trips for team building, networking, and fun (past trips include Dubai, Singapore & Hong Kong)

Responsibilities:

jobs.title: Face Deduplication Collection
jobs.description:
The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS.

The focus is on capturing real-world variation across lighting, poses, expressions, accessories, environments, and aging to improve model accuracy and robustness. The collection includes:

• Current Neutral Selfies – clean frontal selfies serving as high-quality identity references, with natural variation in appearance and surroundings.

• Current Head-Pose Captures – selfies captured in assigned head directions to introduce pose variation.

• Historical Images – older photos from participants’ galleries to capture natural aging and long-term appearance changes.

The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS.

To qualify for payment, you must submit a minimum of 20 valid images. The maximum payout is based on 24 accepted images. Due to the strict automated and manual Quality Control (QC) process, we strongly recommend submitting 30 images to help ensure that enough images remain valid after review

No specific education is needed to perform the project task.

Senior Google Ads Account Managers should possess:

  1. Advanced knowledge of Google Ads and how to create and manage profitable campaigns for ecommerce and lead-generation businesses.
